#if FOO
extension ClosureParameterSyntax: SyntaxExpressibleByStringInterpolation
{}
enum Voluntary<T> : Equatable {
  case Naught
  case Mere(T)
  case Twain(T, )
  func enumMethod(_ other: Voluntary<T>, foo: Foo) {
    switch self {
    case other:
      ()
    case .Naught,
         .Naught(),
         .Naught(_),
         .Naught(_, _):
      ()
    case .Mere,
         .Mere(),
         .Mere(_),
         .Mere(_, _):
      ()
    case .Twain(),
         .Twain(_),
         .Twain(_, _),
         .Twain(_, _, _):
      ()
    }
    switch foo {
    case .Naught:
      ()
    case .A, .B, .C:
      ()
    }
  }
}
#endif
